SINGLE-EDITOR REVISION MODEL
A reviewed version stays exact while editing continues
This local sandbox uses the recorded feature definition and inherited authoring validator. It has no network, database or collaborative transport.
  1. Freeze the reviewed version.
  2. Continue editing the repair limit.
  3. Publish the reviewed version and compare the two limits.
Complete current state and action history


Scope: actual two-replica Yjs probes, controlled in-memory publication and a 100-node fixture. This does not qualify the complete editor, authenticated history, production validation or five-user/native-run release journey.
